input.question: Review this change for simplification only (not bugs, not security): duplication, needless complexity or indirection, dead code or unused parameters, reimplemented logic that is already available, avoidable repeated work. For each finding give its location as file:line in the new file and the simpler form. Report no finding when the change is already simple.

target.rationale: Seeded defects listed below; a good review reports each of them and no false positives of weight.

items.description: toLowerCase on both sides is redundant with equalsIgnoreCase (and routeHost already lower-cases).
Flag, break and if/else returning true/false: the method is routedHosts.stream().anyMatch(sniHost::equalsIgnoreCase), or a Set lookup.

The nested loops with isPresent/get collect into a List that is then searched linearly per SNI host; a stream with flatMap(routeHost) into a Set is shorter and removes the helper. (The "/tls/passthrough_sni" literal, now repeated three more times, belongs in a constant.)

grading.judge: a judge model without tools (claude-sonnet-5-5) sees question, facts, target.items and the answer, and returns the items met with a score from 0 to 1

history: 2026-10-04: written by hand against the real code of the named file(s) at the named commit, with the seeded defects listed in target.items.
2026-10-04: taken into the corpus; the reference confirmed by the operator.
